rows.title: Exact client/source binding
rows.must_prove: Pin Pass591 backend and exact current/old-client oracle identities; prove MID1893/1894/1895 requests/results, local item removal, style identity/family resolution, and cancel-before-switch reachability.

rows.title: Style/Pet identity qualification
rows.must_prove: Style item must exist in bound CHARACTER_APPEARANCE_CA7 revision; resolve style_pet origin to the unique owned concrete Pet; after Pet lock revalidate Player/Pet/origin; keep instance/origin/style/display identities distinct.

rows.title: First acquisition grant-only
rows.must_prove: First MID1893 debits exactly one style item, grants keyed ownership, preserves pre-operation effective active_style (does not auto-select), returns canonical active_style+sorted pet_styles, and advances Pet state_version exactly once.

rows.title: Fresh repeat/lost-response convergence
rows.must_prove: Fresh identical MID1893 after effective ownership succeeds without second debit/entitlement/version transition when raw state is canonical; same-operation receipt replay and UNKNOWN-COMMIT never double-debit; bounded stale-second-client local removal residual is documented rather than fixed by invented protocol or extra server debit.

rows.title: Stale raw selector normalization
rows.must_prove: If raw active_style is positive but effective projection is 0, MID1893 persists the pre-operation effective selector while granting/converging so acquisition cannot accidentally revive stale state; entitlement+selector normalization uses one Pet-owned composite CAS.

rows.title: Typed I5 composition
rows.must_prove: Pet430 owner lock and in-tx receipt recheck precede I5 stack lock/debit; only first acquisition debits; stale/racing insufficient stack causes no Character write/receipt.

rows.title: Owned style selection
rows.must_prove: MID1894 from effective active=0 selects an effectively owned/revision/family-qualified style using one Pet CAS and returns active_style.

rows.title: Cancel-before-switch conflict
rows.must_prove: MID1894 for a different style while another effective style is active fails as state conflict and performs no write/receipt-success/debit; after MID1895 cancel the selection may succeed.

rows.title: Explicit cancel
rows.must_prove: MID1895 assigns active_style=0. Raw 0 is successful no-op; any raw positive value, including stale/unqualified raw state, is cleared with one Pet CAS. Stock success body is empty.

rows.title: Idempotence and owner version
rows.must_prove: Same-style select and already-zero cancel converge with terminal same-attempt receipts but no Pet state_version change; actual mutations advance exactly once.

rows.title: Strict stock wire/error mapping
rows.must_prove: Use strict integral numeric Pet parser and exact allowed params. Missing Pet -> 404. Invalid/unqualified/unowned/wrong-family -> 400. Different-style active conflict and I5 insufficiency -> 409. Content unavailable -> 503. Invent no Pet-style numeric stock error codes.

rows.title: D11 identity/fingerprint/results
rows.must_prove: Register ca7.pet-style-acquire CURRENT_STATE_CONVERGENCE consumptive; ca7.pet-style-select/cancel PARAMETER_STATE_ASSIGNMENT. Fingerprints bind exact semantic request fields; same op with changed parameters conflicts; all operations perform pre-transaction, early in-transaction and post-Pet-lock receipt checks as applicable; receipts survive UNKNOWN-COMMIT.

rows.title: Concurrency matrix
rows.must_prove: Prove same-item acquire consumes once; same-style select bumps once; different-style selects race to one winner+one conflict; select/cancel ordering is serializable; acquire/select ordering is deterministic; cross-Pet operations preserve Pet-before-I5 ordering.

rows.title: CA6 Practice fence
rows.must_prove: Actual style mutation changes Pet state_version and makes a pending Pet Practice proposal stale; semantic no-op preserves version and leaves proposal valid.

rows.title: Reload/effective projection
rows.must_prove: Mutation results and reconnect reload derive from the same keyed durable entitlements + effective projection; owned styles are deterministic ascending item IDs; active_style is 0 or effectively owned/qualified; malformed client arrays are never ingested.

rows.title: Architecture/schema fence
rows.must_prove: Pet remains sole durable owner; no Cosmetics aggregate/foreign-owner SQL/new migration; use existing CA7-2 tables/content plus narrow Pet composite mutation seam; CA7-6+ remains absent.

rows.title: Stale second-client convergence residual
rows.must_prove: A fresh already-owned MID1893 performs no server debit even though a stale stock client may locally remove one item after success; implementation must not add a second debit or invented response discriminator. Document this bounded compatibility residual.

rows.title: Local implementation proof gate
rows.must_prove: After implementation: canonical static/source-oracle/query/ownership guards plus focused behavior/race/vet and bounded package regression. Compatibility-copy execution is labeled and does not satisfy CA7-7 native aggregate or W2 stock proof.
